items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Then when he went to Claude Clark Monroe's Uptown House, he started saying, 'Come on, Lady; come on, Lady,' and he started saying Lady Day.

ctx.x: The reason I asked you that, Jo, was to get back to Billie Holiday. I have heard and I just want to clear it for the record because I'm sure you were there, that Billie Holiday named Lester Young "Pres" and that he named her "Lady Day". Now do you have any things to say about that?

I will tell you the truth about that. How Lady Day become known as Lady Day, it started in Baltimore and this was a personal thing. I was always Little Lord Fauntleroy. We were leaving the Royal Theatre and you know how we used to go in the back to get the food, in the house. So we were sitting in the bus to get the food and Freddie Green was sitting with Lady Day.
